label: PF Backlog 197
title: Backend: generator-model adapters (open-weights image/video/audio)
body:
## Problem / why
No model in our catalog OUTPUTS media, so image/video/audio generation is impossible.

## Goal
Register generator models + provider adapters (local open-weights and/or APIs) and expose them to the
modality layer (core/modality.py generators_needed()).

## In scope
- Adapters for open-weights first (Wan 2.2 Apache-2.0, FLUX.1-schnell Apache-2.0, Kokoro/Whisper, ACE-Step).
- License metadata per generator (permissive vs restricted) so distribution is safe.

## Acceptance criteria
- generators_needed() reports 0 for a supported modality once its generator is registered.
- Each generator carries license info and is only offered when permitted.

## Verification / test plan
- Generate one image + one audio clip through the adapter; license field present.

## Added — provider-agnostic generator infra (from docs/multimodal_orchestration.md §10–16)
- Support ALL provider kinds (not text-only): chat/vision/image-gen/video-gen/tts/stt/music/3d/embedding/timeseries/rerank.
- Two provider shapes: DIRECT (OpenAI Images, Google Imagen/Veo, ElevenLabs, Stability, Runway, Meshy/Tripo)
  and AGGREGATORS (fal.ai, Replicate, kie.ai - one key/base URL, many models).
- Adapter contract: submit(kind,payload)->job, status(job), fetch(job)->artifact, cancel, cost(job).
  Handle ASYNC jobs (video/music/3d: submit->poll/webhook->fetch) vs sync (image/tts/chat).
- Include FREE (self-host open-weights: Wan 2.2, FLUX.1-schnell, Kokoro, Whisper, MusicGen/ACE-Step)
  AND paid providers; carry license + open_weights + free flags.
- Catalog entries need: kind, provider_kind, billing_unit, unit_price, free, open_weights, license.

## Acceptance criteria (add)
- An agent can call a non-text kind end-to-end through the adapter interface (image+audio at least).
- Aggregator provider usable with one key; a self-host provider usable with no key.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend capability; consumed via API, no UI change.
